messages.subject: Re: Error when uploading environmental rasters
messages.body_plain:
Hallo,
thanks for this discussion, I have the same problem when using Chelsa climatic variables downloaded from their server. Bio variables work fine but when using some others, I encounter the same problem as mentioned above. I am also interested in code to process my rasters so the NA values match.
Thanks!
Martin

Dne čtvrtek 23. února 2023 v 21:09:52 UTC+1 uživatel Wallace Ecological Modeling App napsal:

> Hello to both,
>
> This warning is just an indication that your environmental rasters have unidentical/unmatching pixels with NA values. You should be able to carry on with your analyses, however, this warning will prevent you from running the three modules within the 'Env Space' (Characterize Environmental Space) component. Wallace removes pixels with NA values where an occurrence record falls, so if multiple species are uploaded and the NA values don't match, it would crash. So to eliminate problems, we added the warning. If you'd like to run the Characterize Environmental space, I can give you code to process your rasters so the NA values match, although I wouldn't advise modeling with these rasters, as it is removing information in place of NA values.
>
> I hope that settled your confusion and let me know if you are having any problems.
>
> Bethany Johnson
>
> On Thursday, February 23, 2023 at 4:49:38 AM UTC-5 Simon H wrote:
> > I've experienced similar errors, which I have yet to fully resolve. In my case I suspect it has to do with scale and offset settings in some raster files. I would guess that the NAflag is improperly read by Wallace, depending on which driver was used to write the raster during my env data pre processing. In my case it could also be the other way around, that the NA settings are improperly implemented in the writeraster function.
> > On Tuesday, February 14, 2023 at 6:03:39 PM UTC+1 mti...@pucp.edu.pe wrote:
> > > Hello all: I've trying to upload my environmental layers but I keep getting this error warning: "Input rasters have unmatching NAs pixel values" ...any suggestion/solution? Thanks!

messages.subject_clean: Resolving Transfer to New Time Error in Wallace Ecological Modelling APP
messages.body_plain:
Hello
Everybody,

We've
run into an error message when transferring to new time in our modelling
process. It's limited to resolutions higher than 30 arc seconds, which can be
frustrating for finer resolutions.

Let's
discuss why this is the case and how we can fix it. Are there any technical
challenges in enabling transfer to finer resolutions? Any alternative solutions
or workarounds that we can try?

Please
share your thoughts and ideas. Let's find a way to improve our modelling
process.

Thank
you!

I introduce the occurrences and the bioclimatic variables. When I try to save that background as ASCII, a new tab appears but the file is not downloaded, the same happens if I want to do it in GeoTIFF, it only lets me download shapefiles or .csv. In previous versions I used the same occurrence data and the same bioclimatic variables and yes I can download the background.

In R it appears from the beginning:

Listening on http://127.0.0.1:3507

Hakan Gür, 1993-2007 yılları arasında lisans, yüksek lisans ve doktora öğrenimini Hacettepe Üniversitesi, Fen Fakültesi, Biyoloji Bölümü’nde tamamlamıştır. Yüksek lisans ve doktora çalışmaları, sırasıyla Anadolu yer sincaplarının populasyon biyolojisi ve biyocoğrafyası ile ilgilidir. 2008 yılında Ahi Evran Üniversitesi, Fen-Edebiyat Fakültesi, Biyoloji Bölümü’ne atanmıştır. 2009 yılında “Richardson yer sincaplarının yaşam öyküsü özellikleri ve fenolojisi üzerine iklimsel etkiler” başlıklı çalışması ile Lethbridge Üniversitesi (Alberta, Kanada), Fen-Edebiyat Fakültesi, Biyolojik Bilimler Bölümü’nün ‘Karasal Ekoloji Doktora Sonrası Araştırma Bursu’nu kazanmıştır. Son yıllarda genel olarak yer sincaplarının ekolojisi ve biyocoğrafyası üzerine yaptığı çalışmalarını, moleküler filocoğrafya ve ekolojik niş modellemesi yaklaşımlarını kullanarak, küresel iklim değişikliklerinin omurgalı türlerinin coğrafi dağılımını ve genetik yapısını nasıl etkilediği/etkileyeceği üzerine yoğunlaştırmıştır.
